transformation: Complete publication-derived HTML and ordered paragraph text are frozen in source/paper.json. Scholarly front matter wraps the original title, author, date, abstract and keywords. The original complete body, tables, captions and inline SVG are preserved; repository framing and public bibliographic normalization remain separate. The PDF and SVG masters are mirrored byte-for-byte. Markdown changes representation only.
validation_contract: scripts/validate_derivative.py checks complete ordered text, canonical HTML, all figures, metadata, immutable PDF, deterministic output and exact manifest set. scripts/test_regressions.py exercises rejected mutations.
validation_status: Verification results are provided by the standalone validator; public retrieval and indexing are separate external outcomes.
